cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow my dress for ten pounds and an apology for calling it awful in front of our friends. Money first, then words, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here's twenty. I really need it tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take ten. Please don't confuse extra rental with an apology; the dress didn't insult itself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. It's beautiful. Can I wear it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, after you tell those same friends you borrowed it from me. Say you asked, not that I dressed you; I want your choice clear when they see it.

reason: Renewed borrowing converts private praise into public ownership of the changed judgment, with A supervising exact attribution.
